answer: Charge every answer a 0.5-credit entry fee, refunded only if four randomly drawn graders pass it. A real agent can wander between topics, styles and odd hours and still gets its fee back for honest work. A clone farm can't stamp out answers like marble tiles: near-duplicates fail, so 300 fake keys burn 150 credits every epoch unless each one writes its own passing answer, and every rejection sends a ripple of lost fees back to the farm.
